executiveSummary: Surveillance reports from ECDC (weeks 16-20, 2026) and PAHO (Oct 2025–May 2026) indicate multiple concurrent biological threats across the Americas and Europe. Avian Influenza A(H5N1) in the Americas represents the most critical select agent concern, with ongoing animal-to-human spillover risk flagged in both November 2025 and March 2026 PAHO updates. Additional elevated threats include Mpox circulating in the Americas, Yellow Fever activity, and the start of the Southern Hemisphere influenza season coinciding with RSV co-circulation. Dengue, Chikungunya, Measles, Pertussis, and Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome contribute to a high-burden multi-pathogen environment across the region.
bottomLine: Avian Influenza A(H5N1) zoonotic spillover risk in the Americas, combined with simultaneous circulation of Mpox, Yellow Fever, Dengue, and resurgent Measles and Pertussis, presents a complex multi-threat public health environment requiring heightened surveillance and rapid response capacity.

threats.name: Avian Influenza A(H5N1)
signals: Two separate PAHO epidemiological updates issued November 2025 and March 2026 indicating sustained zoonotic activity
Ongoing animal reservoir activity with human spillover risk in the Americas
BSL-3 select agent with pandemic potential requiring heightened monitoring
threats.action: Activate enhanced zoonotic surveillance at human-animal interfaces; ensure PPE and antiviral stockpiles at high-exposure sites; coordinate with agricultural and wildlife agencies; prepare pandemic contingency protocols

threats.name: Mpox
signals: PAHO epidemiological update issued April 23 2026 indicating active transmission in the Americas
Sustained community circulation requiring ongoing contact tracing
BSL-3 pathogen with potential for multi-country spread
threats.action: Strengthen case detection and contact tracing; expand vaccination coverage for high-risk populations; coordinate cross-border data sharing with PAHO member states

threats.name: Yellow Fever
signals: PAHO epidemiological alert issued March 13 2026 indicating active cases
Vaccine-preventable disease with high case fatality risk in unvaccinated populations
Sylvatic and urban transmission cycles of concern in endemic zones
threats.action: Ensure vaccination coverage in at-risk regions; enhance vector surveillance and control; alert travelers and verify vaccination requirements for affected areas

threats.name: Dengue
signals: PAHO epidemiological update issued February 18 2026 indicating elevated case counts
Continued hyperendemic circulation across multiple serotypes in the Americas
Risk of severe dengue and healthcare system strain
threats.action: Intensify vector control and community prevention campaigns; enhance clinical surveillance for severe dengue; ensure blood supply safety protocols are in place

threats.name: Seasonal Influenza and RSV Co-circulation
threats.pathogen: Influenza A/B viruses; Respiratory Syncytial Virus
signals: PAHO alert April 27 2026 marking start of Southern Hemisphere influenza season
PAHO alert January 9 2026 flagging simultaneous influenza and RSV circulation
ECDC weekly threat reports weeks 16-20 2026 covering European respiratory season
Healthcare surge risk from dual respiratory pathogen burden
threats.action: Promote influenza vaccination uptake; prepare healthcare systems for surge capacity; monitor for novel influenza variants; coordinate RSV prophylaxis for vulnerable populations

threats.name: Measles
signals: PAHO epidemiological alert issued February 3 2026 indicating active cases
Risk of outbreaks in under-vaccinated communities following pandemic-era immunization gaps
Highly contagious pathogen threatening elimination status in the Americas
threats.action: Conduct vaccination coverage assessments and catch-up campaigns; strengthen outbreak investigation capacity; verify import and export case reporting linkages

threats.name: Pertussis (Whooping Cough)
signals: Two PAHO updates issued December 2025 and March 2026 indicating sustained elevated activity
Resurgence likely linked to waning immunity and immunization gaps
Infants and unvaccinated individuals at highest risk of severe disease
threats.action: Review and strengthen routine immunization schedules including Tdap boosters; enhance surveillance in neonatal and pediatric settings; investigate laboratory confirmation rates

threats.name: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome
threats.pathogen: Sin Nombre virus / Andes virus (Hantavirus spp.)
signals: PAHO epidemiological alert issued December 19 2025 indicating active HPS cases
High case fatality rate associated with cardiopulmonary syndrome
Person-to-person transmission risk for Andes virus in South America
threats.action: Enhance rodent exposure prevention education; strengthen clinical recognition and early referral protocols; investigate clustering of cases for potential person-to-person transmission signals

selectAgentSummary: Two BSL-3/BSL-4 relevant pathogens were identified in these reports. Avian Influenza A(H5N1) is a CDC/USDA Select Agent and BSL-3 pathogen with pandemic potential, flagged in two separate PAHO updates (November 2025 and March 2026) for sustained zoonotic activity in the Americas, warranting Critical threat classification. Monkeypox virus (MPXV), a BSL-3 pathogen and former HHS/USDA select agent, is actively circulating in the Americas per the April 2026 PAHO update, warranting Elevated threat classification. Both require enhanced biosafety protocols, restricted laboratory handling, and coordinated public health response.
amrSignals: No explicit AMR-specific reports identified in the 21 surveillance reports reviewed; however, Bordetella pertussis macrolide resistance warrants monitoring given resurgence signals in the Americas
Increased healthcare utilization from multi-pathogen burden may drive inappropriate antibiotic use, elevating secondary AMR risk in the Americas
emergingPatterns: Simultaneous multi-pathogen respiratory co-circulation (influenza, RSV) stressing healthcare systems in both Northern and Southern Hemisphere transition periods
Resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases (Measles, Pertussis) suggesting immunization coverage gaps likely attributable to pandemic-era disruptions persisting into 2025-2026
Sustained A(H5N1) zoonotic activity in the Americas across two consecutive reporting periods indicates ongoing epizootic not yet contained
Arboviral threat convergence with Dengue, Chikungunya, and Yellow Fever co-circulating in overlapping geographic zones in the Americas, amplifying Aedes mosquito-borne disease burden
PAHO alert on GLP-1 receptor agonist medication misuse represents an emerging non-communicable pharmacovigilance signal intersecting with health system capacity
